# Vetta 0.6.31
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-27 -->

## English

### Improvements

- The New / Edit workspace dialog now shows a pixel-art illustration on the left (hidden when the window is narrow), and the Export diagnostics dialog has a new pixel-art banner.

### Fixes

- On Windows, the interface now uses Segoe UI and Microsoft YaHei UI instead of the generic fallback font, aiming to fix text that looked blurry compared with the browser.
- On Windows, the UI design canvas no longer stays blank when the project is on a different drive than the system drive (e.g. D:).

## 中文

### 改进

- 新建/编辑工作空间弹窗左侧加了一幅像素风插画（窗口较窄时自动隐藏），导出诊断包弹窗顶部也换成了像素风插画。

### 修复

- Windows 上界面改用 Segoe UI 与微软雅黑 UI 显示，不再退回系统默认字体，用于改善文字比浏览器里发虚的问题。
- Windows 上项目放在非系统盘（如 D 盘）时，UI 设计画布不再一片空白。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.30...v0.6.31
